title: rosa glauca f. intermedia
intro: Rosa glauca f. intermedia, commonly known as the Red-leaved Rose or Purple Rose, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. This shrub is known for its vibrant red-purple foliage and fragrant flowers. The health benefits of Rosa glauca f. intermedia include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation.
